cards.card_text: Covetous gain Foreign gods Proud rulers
cards.verse_text: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.
cards.snippet: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.

cards.card_text: Then Paul says sin seized its opportunity through the commandment and produced in him every kind of covetous desire.
cards.verse_text: But sin, seizing its opportunity through the commandment, produced in me every kind of covetous desire.
cards.snippet: …seizing its opportunity through the commandment, produced in me every kind of covetous desire.
